name: compusync
description: Native cursor linking and Chrome window handoff across two laptops.
author: CompuSync

scripts.test:native: node scripts/run-cargo.cjs test --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --lib && node scripts/run-cargo.cjs test --locked --manifest-path native/recovery-guard/Cargo.toml && node scripts/run-cargo.cjs test --locked --manifest-path native/windows-audio/Cargo.toml --target-dir native/target/windows-audio && node scripts/run-cargo.cjs test --locked --manifest-path native/chrome-host/Cargo.toml && node --test native/index.test.cjs native/audio.test.cjs
scripts.build: npm run native:build && npm run native:smoke && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run native:build && npm run native:smoke && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run native:build && npm run native:smoke && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: CompuSync captures your Mac's system audio when you choose to play it on your paired Windows laptop.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: CompuSync connects to your other laptop to link cursors and hand off Chrome windows.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: CompuSync needs Accessibility access to move the shared cursor and position Chrome windows during handoff.
extendInfo.NSInputMonitoringUsageDescription: CompuSync needs Input Monitoring access so your mouse and keyboard can follow the shared cursor.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: CompuSync needs Automation access to read and recreate Chrome tabs and to send messages you compose in Messages Companion.
